An exact release date will be announced in December, the company said, and people are theorizing that could mean the date will be announced at The Game Awards on December 10. Lords of the Fallen II was originally scheduled to launch in 2026, but CI Games delayed it to Q1 2027 (January-March) to avoid GTA 6 and give the team more time to polish the experience. Now it's delayed to Q2 2027.
